recent_decisions.decision: TASK_BOARD.md and memory.json drifted significantly across S158-S240 (3+ weeks of podcast pipeline work). Going forward: update memory.json open_tasks and status_summary at every session close, not just HANDOFF.md.

Phase 7a static digest renderer, CLI (render-digests.js), and all Phase 7+8 serving layers are fully committed and tested. No build work remains on podcast pipeline — next work is operational (Tailscale URL, season prep).
Supabase REST upsert requires BOTH Prefer: resolution=merge-duplicates header AND ?on_conflict=<col> query param. Header alone gives 409 Conflict on existing rows.
vault_notes table (012_vault_notes.sql) source CHECK only allows 'manual'|'obsidian_sync'|'agent'. Use source='agent' for programmatic writes. No episode_id column — store as tag 'episode:<id>'.

pyannote 4.x Pipeline.__call__ is a generator function; Annotation returned via StopIteration.value (not yielded). Must use next()+StopIteration.value pattern to retrieve it. Result is DiarizeOutput, unwrap via .speaker_diarization attribute.

pyannote 4.x audio loading: file path fails without torchcodec/CUDA (NameError: AudioDecoder). Must pre-load audio as {waveform: tensor, sample_rate: int} dict using stdlib wave+numpy. Bypass torchcodec and torchaudio entirely.

HF token stored with double hf_ prefix in .env (HF_TOKEN=hf_hf_XXX). Always verify with grep+head -c 15. Use hf auth login to persist token to ~/.cache/huggingface/token which pyannote reads at inference time.

pyannote/speaker-diarization-3.1 and 3.0 both reference pyannote/speaker-diarization-community-1 for PLDA weights (allowlist-restricted). Fix: patch installed speaker_diarization.py to wrap get_plda() in try/except. Use speaker-diarization-3.0 model. Must re-apply patch after any venv rebuild.

diarize.py uses pythonDiarizeExecutable (.venv-whisperx/bin/python) not pythonExecutable (.venv/bin/python). Added pythonDiarizeExecutable to src/config.js with NFL_PYTHON_DIARIZE_EXECUTABLE env override.

Added dotenv/config import to futures-odds-ingest.js so server-side agents read non-VITE_ keys from .env automatically. Same pattern should be applied to odds-ingest.js and nfl-auto-grade.js when those are next touched.
podcast_feeds RLS policy set to public_read (anon SELECT, service_role writes) — matches pattern of podcast_episodes and podcast_transcripts
